aaee6c3d34a8763f497bdb5450df274b5f92e979: Artesina offers 105 km of well-marked runs — a mid-sized ski area ideal for spending 4 to 5 days without ever doing exactly the same thing twice. The 24 lifts are generally enough to handle the crowds in high season. Artesina's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Southern Alps for getting children started on skiing. Artesina's altitude (1320 m at the base, 2085 m at the top) helps it keep decent snow cover in the depths of winter. January and February are the most reliable months; in December and March, it is worth checking conditions before finalising a booking. The budget for a stay in Artesina is clearly high: 52€ for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants among the most expensive in the Alps. It is the price of excellence — but be aware of it before you go. In short: Artesina lives up to its promises. A resort in the Southern Alps that will suit most skier profiles without disappointing.
